title: Purple Hammer Warrior
description: A fierce female warrior with purple hair stands in a dynamic combat stance, gripping a massive purple warhammer with both hands. She wears a white and purple cropped outfit with armored gauntlets, leg wraps, and sandals, set against a solid dark gray background.
prompt: A fierce young woman with short purple hair in a dynamic fighting stance, wielding a very large purple warhammer with crackled lightning patterns on the head. She wears a white cropped top with purple trim, white pants with purple accents, armored purple gauntlets and leg wraps, and sandals. Athletic build, confident expression, solid dark gray background, clean comic book style digital illustration with bold outlines and vibrant colors.
